title: getlogisticsdashboardrecentbookings
description: Verify that GET /logistics returns a dashboard view with recent bookings for an authenticated user.

title: getlogisticsmanageallbookingslistview
description: Verify that GET /logistics/manage returns the bookings management view listing all bookings for an authenticated user.

title: postlogisticsajaxdatatablepaginatedbookingslist
description: Verify that POST /logistics/ajax-datatable returns a 200 response with a server-side paginated and searchable bookings dataset for authenticated requests.

title: postlogisticsdeleteidatomicbookingdeletion
description: Verify that POST /logistics/delete/{id} atomically deletes the booking and all child shipment items when a valid booking id is provided.

title: postlogisticsdeleteidinvalididerrorresponse
description: Verify that POST /logistics/delete/{id} with an invalid or missing id returns an error response and does not delete any booking.

title: gettrackinghistorybookingidchronologicalupdates
description: Verify that GET /tracking/history/{booking_id} returns a 200 response with chronological tracking history for the specified booking id.

title: posttrackingsavecreatesupdatesrecordwithpod
description: Verify that POST /tracking/save with valid booking_id, status, location, event date/time, and optional POD file creates or updates a tracking record successfully.

title: posttrackingsaveinvalidfieldserrorresponse
description: Verify that POST /tracking/save with invalid or missing required tracking fields returns an error response and does not commit any tracking record.

title: posttrackingdeleteidharddeletetrackingrecord
description: Verify that POST /tracking/delete/{id} with a valid tracking record id permanently removes the tracking record and returns a 200 response.

title: postmastersajaxdatatabletypepaginatedlisting
description: Verify that POST /masters/ajax-datatable/{type} with a valid master type and search/pagination parameters returns a 200 response with a paginated master listing.
